title: Apple's iPhone Duo Fails Durability Test After Launch
excerpt: Apple's new foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, has reportedly failed a well-known durability test just one day after its market release.
body_html:
Apple has faced a setback following the release of its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo. Just a day after hitting the market, the newly launched device failed a popular durability test.

The failure during basic durability testing comes as a notable challenge for the company regarding its latest hardware release. Further details concerning the specific test results or structural issues were not immediately detailed in the initial reports.
